title: Co-projection compatibility with normalized etale exceptional pullback
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum of [sk-def-purity-conv], with $A=A_{E,n}$, and work in the bounded constructible finite-Tor pro-etale categories with the operations of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion of separated finite-type $k$-schemes, let $e:U\to X$ be a separated finite-type étale morphism, and put $V=Z\times_XU$ with maps $v:V\to Z$ and $i_U:V\hookrightarrow U$. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-scheme-base-change], $v$ is étale. Let $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude] and let $L\in D^b_{ctf}(X,A)$ be tensor-invertible; the exceptional inverse images preserve the bounded constructible finite-Tor categories [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], so $Ri^!K$, $Re^!K$ and $K\otimes^LL$ again lie in them. Use the normalized comparisons $\rho_e:Re^!\simeq Le^*$ and $\rho_v:Rv^!\simeq Lv^*$ of [lem-pur-finite-etale-dualizing-normalization], and the canonical exceptional composition comparisons $c_{g,f}:R(gf)^!\simeq Rf^!Rg^!$ of [pur9-def-upper-shriek-composition]. Define the comparison by the explicit five-arrow pasting
$$B_{e,i,K}:Ri_U^!Le^*K\xrightarrow{Ri_U^!(\rho_{e,K}^{-1})}Ri_U^!Re^!K\xrightarrow{c_{e,i_U,K}^{-1}}R(ei_U)^!K=R(iv)^!K\xrightarrow{c_{i,v,K}}Rv^!Ri^!K\xrightarrow{\rho_{v,Ri^!K}}Lv^*Ri^!K.$$ 
Then the canonical co-projection isomorphisms of [lem-pur-coprojection] form a commutative square
$$
\begin{array}{ccc}
Ri_U^!\bigl(Le^*(K\otimes^L L)\bigr)&\xrightarrow{\operatorname{coProj}_{i_U}}&Ri_U^!Le^*K\otimes^L Li_U^*Le^*L\\
\downarrow B_{e,i,K\otimes L}&&\downarrow B_{e,i,K}\otimes\mathrm{can}\\
Lv^*Ri^!(K\otimes^L L)&\xrightarrow{\,Lv^*\operatorname{coProj}_{i}}&Lv^*Ri^!K\otimes^L Lv^*Li^*L,
\end{array}
$$
where $\mathrm{can}:Li_U^*Le^*L\simeq Lv^*Li^*L$ is the canonical pullback-composition identification. In particular, the co-projection isomorphism for a Tate twist and shift commutes with replacing each etale exceptional inverse image by its normalized ordinary pullback comparison.
